items.zh: SDK 新增 responsesup：OpenAI Responses API 上游方言包，与 anthropicup / openaiup 并列，插件可直接反代 Responses 形态的上游
items.en: SDK: new responsesup package — OpenAI Responses API upstream dialect alongside anthropicup / openaiup, so plugins can proxy Responses-shaped upstreams directly

items.zh: SDK 新增 ExtraFingerprintHeaders 常量：核心按入口协议生成的客户端指纹头，插件按需采用
items.en: SDK: new ExtraFingerprintHeaders constant — client fingerprint headers generated by the core per entry protocol, adopted by plugins as needed
